verdict.rationale: macOS docs mention Stage Manager as a window-management feature (macos-docs-25), implying support for organizing windows into layouts, but hands-on community reports directly contradict this — describing basic window resize/snap as broken or missing (only draggable from one corner, non-intuitive edge-snapping) and users relying on third-party tools like Moom for functionality Windows/other OSes provide natively. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a true predefined-layout tiling feature (e.g., explicit Split View grid presets), independent hands-on praise confirming smooth native snapping, and resolution of the community complaints about clunky window operations in recent macOS versions.
